title: Hoshino Ichika — My All In This Sound〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Diner

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line: Finally, I have a deluxe chocolate banana parfait.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, that's mine.
Thank you.
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That parfait's huge, Ichika.
Look at all the layers of banana slices and chocolate.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, it's big, but I feel like I can finish the whole thing right now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyway, now that we all have what we ordered, it's time to start digging in! Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Honami, Ichika & Shiho
rows.Line: Let's eat.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Mmm... So good...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
This is just what my tired brain was craving.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We did end up having a fairly lengthy discussion regarding our staging.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! And this is the ideal reward for all our hard work♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We still have a few things left to decide, but I'm glad that we were able to agree on an overall plan for our performance.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Me too. But none of it will matter if we can't actually perform like we planned.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, we'll need to push ourselves even harder than usual until the show.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Still, Ichika, I feel like you have the hardest job out of all of us...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah... We're having you and Shiho play back-to-back solos on your guitar and bass now. And with the new arrangement, you even have to change how you sing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let us know if you ever need our help with anything, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She's right. We'll need to strike a good balance when we do our solos, so we should work on them together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I can also help you keep time while you practice, so please let me know if you'd like me to help.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks, everyone...
That really means a lot.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (They're right about me having a lot on my plate...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (As the opening act, we have to warm up an audience who came to see Free Cluster perform, not us.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And to do that...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I have to put on a powerful performance like her, and really strike at the heart through my singing.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (A performance that allows us to move their hearts and unite the whole arena with our music. I have to—)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Ichi?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I was just thinking, I guess. I was remembering that performance we saw from Ms. Naruse on that video site.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ms. Naruse?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. She knows how to work her audience, and her singing voice just seems to naturally resonate with your heart.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
She does everything at such a high level.
From playing her guitar to singing, she's just a great performer overall.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah...
That's why she's able to put on such compelling performances.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Free Cluster's an incredible band, and we're going to open for them. That means we have to put on the best show possible, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
And to do that...
I want to get as close as I can to what Ms. Naruse does as she sings and plays her guitar.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's going to involve a lot of work, but I plan on doing every single thing I can to get even a step closer.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So that we're able to put on amazing shows like her and her band.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I agree...
Let's give it all we've got, and get as close as we can.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
Let's grow a ton and put on a performance that really moves the crowd's hearts!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And to make that happen...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We need to recharge our batteries!
So, Ichi, here! You can have one of my strawberries!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, are you sure? Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, you can have some of my apple sherbet.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'll give you some of my pudding.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Wait, you're making too big a pile! It's going to collapse...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hurry! You gotta eat everything now!
